newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Monday the prices and movements of steers exported Friday from Mexico through Nogales, Ariz.
About 900 head mostly between 300 to 500 lbs crossed the border. Feeder steers from 300 to 400 lbs sold from 67 to 77 cents/lb. Steers 400 to 500 lbs were sold from 62 to 67 cents/lb, USDA said.
Trade was steady compared to the previous day, USDA said, with "trade moderate, demand good."
About 150 head mostly 300 to 600 lbs passed through Hidalgo, Texas on Friday, but not enough were sold for indicative market prices.
